# Skipped tests that do not fail a macOS job (skips.sh): package suffix (or *),
# a regexp over the top-level test's name, and optionally a substring of the
# skip's reason. Anything else that skips is a missing prerequisite.
#
# Live tests: they need Apple's servers, an account or Google's CDM download.
internal/applemusic TestLive.*
internal/motion TestLiveRendition.*
internal/playback/cdm TestLiveDownload.*
# Evidence writers: they draw pictures for a pull request when asked.
* .*Evidence
# Motion artwork's decoder is there on macOS, so the tests of its absence
# have nothing to run, and one reads a file the environment names.
internal/ui/media TestOpenMotionWithoutDecoder
internal/ui/media TestMotionFileOfTheCache
# D-Bus is Linux's session bus.
* .* dbus-daemon not available
# Goldens and pixel readings are compared on Linux only: Pango shapes the text
# there, Core Text draws it differently.
* .* on Linux only
# PipeWire and /proc are Linux's.
internal/playback/native TestEqualizerAndDeviceFollowHosts
internal/playback/gst TestFilePipelineMovesOutputInEveryState
internal/ui/probe/measure TestTreeUsageOfThisProcess
